name: -06 AN 45 Degree Female Push-Loc Fitting
title: -06 AN 45 Degree Female Push-Loc Fitting
description:
The -06 AN 45 Degree Female Push-Loc Fitting is a premium high-performance component engineered for rigorous fluid and boost applications. Whether you’re a professional building a 6-second NHRA bracket car, a perfectionist designing the ultimate engine bay for a SEMA car, or an HPDE enthusiast looking to improve your oil temps, their products are designed for all flavors of motorsports.

ColorFittings products are carefully machined from 6061-T6 Billet Aluminum and finished with their proprietary polish and anodizing process.

Available in unique gloss-finish colors, Push-Loc AN Fittings are designed specifically for use with high-quality Push-Loc hose, and to accept a male AN Flare Fitting.

Technical Specifications:
• Construction: Precision CNC-machined in the USA. (6061-T6 Billet Aluminum for fittings)
• Flow Configuration: 45° mandrel-bent profile for maximum velocity.
